nodes.label: Tesis
nodes.summary: Primitive-content loss governs exit from the permutation regime.

nodes.label: Qué no afirma
nodes.summary: No general Möbius/Farey theory, ergodic theory, full n=5/n=6 classification, minimal base or physics.

nodes.label: Qué sí afirma
nodes.summary: Exact defects/cocycle, sharp 4→5 threshold, arbitrary-n transitive rigidity and effective recognition.

nodes.label: Nicho
nodes.summary: Finite arithmetic realization of rational subdynamics in a coupled projective semigroup.

nodes.label: Glosario
nodes.summary: High component, primitive ray, content, defect, strict edge, Schreier regime, CRT fibre, divisor universe.

nodes.label: Formulario
nodes.summary: T_B, S_B, local gcd defects, content cocycle, cycle identity, divisor universe.

nodes.label: Identidad/presupuesto
nodes.summary: Exact cycle identity and high-cycle budget.

nodes.label: Rigidez transitiva
nodes.summary: One generator n-cycle => the other identity; n<=tau(B-1).

nodes.label: Rigidez n<=4
nodes.summary: Every finite high closed component through four states is permutational.

nodes.label: Realización n=5
nodes.summary: Exact nonpermutation five-state realization on a complete CRT base fibre.

nodes.label: Threshold sharp
nodes.summary: Minimum nonpermutation cardinality equals five.

nodes.label: Decidibilidad fixed-(B,n)
nodes.summary: Every bounded closed problem lies in an explicit finite divisor universe.

nodes.label: Tipos/fibra CRT
nodes.summary: Finite decorated types; fixed primitive tuple has empty or one residue-class fibre.

nodes.label: AND threshold
nodes.summary: Requires FOUR and FIVE.

nodes.label: AND recognition
nodes.summary: Combines type finiteness, CRT fibre and divisor universe.

nodes.label: Kůrka
nodes.summary: Möbius number systems.

nodes.label: Panti 2026
nodes.summary: Farey/projective two-branch classification.

nodes.label: Dajani–Kraaikamp–Sanderson
nodes.summary: Inducing/contraction in Farey natural extensions.

nodes.label: Javaheri 2026
nodes.summary: Rational semigroup transitivity.

nodes.label: Li–Li–Wu
nodes.summary: Rational points in ×b-invariant sets.

nodes.label: Arithmetic dynamics
nodes.summary: Homogeneous lifts/resultant/local arithmetic.

nodes.label: Schreier/semigroups
nodes.summary: Group vs transformation-semigroup regime.

nodes.label: Evidence/provenance
nodes.summary: Claims bind to proofs/certificates/replays with declared jurisdictions.

nodes.label: Revision tests
nodes.summary: Explicit conditions that would force local claims to be reconsidered.

nodes.label: Five-state strict-edge uniqueness
nodes.summary: Proved candidate extension with its scope recorded in the claim ledger.

nodes.label: Later programme
nodes.summary: Full n=5 arithmetic, n=6, elliptic, S-unit/run arithmetic.

nodes.label: Resumen
nodes.summary: Local arithmetic -> global graph restriction -> exact realization.

nodes.label: Ruta demostrativa
nodes.summary: Lift -> defects -> cocycle -> cycle budget -> rigidity -> realization -> recognition.
